title: Eric Bard replicates the anomalies with a neodymium magnet

tellings.quote: he was able to later replicate those anomalies by focusing intense electromagnetic force

plain: A witness at Skinwalker Ranch named Erik Bard reproduced the ranch's strange effects in about 2020 by "focusing intense electromagnetic force" with a neodymium magnet, a very strong kind of permanent magnet. Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah known for reports of odd phenomena. Its owner, a businessman named Brandon Fugal, tells Michels he watched this happen and points to the first season of The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch, a television series filmed there. If true, it would suggest that some of the ranch's oddities have an electromagnetic cause that can be tested.
